name: bookpatch
description: Bookpatch: a social library app for tracking, lending, and discussing the books you own and read

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
